text: “If I were you, Lemoine,” continued Anthony, “I should be very, very careful. Watch your step, and all that sort of thing.” “This time,” said Lemoine grimly, “there will be no mistake.” “You seem very sure about it all,” said Anthony. “But there’s such a thing as evidence, you know.” Lemoine smiled, and something in his smile seemed to attract Anthony’s attention. He sat up and stubbed out his cigarette. “You saw that note I wrote just now?” said the French detective.
